query:
SELECT c.name AS "name!: String",
                  COALESCE(u.display_name, u.username, '') AS "owner!: String"
           FROM camps c
           JOIN users u ON u.id = c.student_id
           WHERE c.id = ?1
             AND (?2 IS NULL OR c.student_id = ?2)
             AND c.archived_at IS NULL
